products.name: PLX InGround Pro 12W
products.tagline: Ultra-slim flush-mount LED for infinity pools
products.description: The PLX InGround Pro 12W is our flagship flush-mount pool light, designed specifically for luxury infinity pools and high-traffic resort swimming pools. With an ultra-slim 8mm bezel and 316L marine-grade stainless steel construction, it sits virtually flush with the pool wall — no protrusion, no hazard for swimmers. Each unit undergoes 100% air-tightness testing and 48-hour submerged pressure testing before leaving our factory.
features: Ultra-slim 8mm bezel — virtually flush with pool wall
316L marine-grade stainless steel — superior chloride & saltwater resistance
100% factory air-tightness + 48hr submerged pressure tested
12V/24V DC low-voltage — absolutely safe for swimmers
DMX512 / 4-Wire Sync controllable — perfect multi-light synchronization
RGBW + Warm White (3000K) — millions of colors + pure warm white
Full glue-filled waterproofing — zero internal cavity for water ingress
50,000-hour LED lifespan — maintenance-free for years

products.name: PLX InGround Slim 9W
products.tagline: Compact wall-mount LED for medium pools & spas

Features the same SS316L marine-grade construction and IP68 waterproofing as our Pro series, in a more compact form factor. Ideal for pools where multiple smaller lights create a more distributed, ambient lighting effect.
features: Compact 90mm diameter — perfect for distributed lighting layouts
316L stainless steel body — full chloride resistance
12V DC ultra-low voltage — human-safe operation
4-Wire synchronous RGBW control — zero color lag
Full epoxy potting — waterproof to 5m depth
CE, RoHS, IP68 certified — approved for commercial use

products.name: PLX Fountain Music 18W
products.tagline: High-power RGBW for musical fountains & large water features
products.description: The PLX Fountain Music 18W is purpose-built for large-scale musical fountains, monumental water features, and architectural landscape installations. Features a built-in center hole (25mm) for water-jet integration, adjustable 0-90° stainless steel mounting bracket, and high-output 18W LED array delivering 2000 lumens. DMX512 protocol ensures frame-perfect synchronization across dozens of fixtures.
features: 25mm center hole — direct water-jet pass-through
0-90° adjustable SS316L bracket — precise beam targeting
High-output 18W LED — 2000lm brightness
DMX512 protocol — zero-lag multi-fixture sync
IP68 + full epoxy potting — permanent submersion rated
RGBW + Warm White — full spectrum color mixing
Tempered glass lens — impact & thermal shock resistant

15mm center hole — thin water jet compatible
Fixed Warm White or RGBW color options
SS316L body — lifetime corrosion resistance
2.5m cable — flexible installation
12V DC low-voltage — safe for public spaces

products.name: PLX Marine Coastal 15W
products.tagline: Extreme saltwater-corrosion LED for beachfront & marinas
products.description: The PLX Marine Coastal 15W is engineered for the harshest marine environments — beachfront resorts, yacht marina docks, and coastal boardwalks where salt spray and high humidity destroy ordinary lights within months. Every component is 316L, every seal is double-gasketed, and every unit passes a 72-hour accelerated salt-spray test (ASTM B117) before shipment.
features: Full 316L construction — including screws, bracket, and housing
72-hour ASTM B117 salt-spray tested — proven marine durability
Double-gasket sealing — redundant water ingress protection
Anti-biofouling lens coating — prevents barnacle & algae buildup
24V DC low-voltage — safe for wet-deck applications
DMX512 / RF Wireless — flexible control options
5-year warranty — our highest warranty tier

seo.title: PLX Marine Coastal 15W | SS316L Saltwater Corrosion-Proof LED Light

products.name: PLX Marine Dock 10W
products.tagline: Compact marina dock & pontoon perimeter light
products.description: The PLX Marine Dock 10W is designed for marina dock edge lighting, floating pontoon perimeter illumination, and boat launch ramp guidance. features: 120° wide beam — perfect for dock & pontoon edge illumination
316L + chemical-resistant silicone — diesel/oil exposure safe
Surface-mount flange — easy retrofit on existing docks
12V DC — intrinsically safe for marina electrical code
Standalone warm white option — no controller needed
3-year warranty — trusted for commercial marina use
